value.rationale: Oscillatory geodesic exponential covariance is a motivated natural model: the unmodulated Laplacian covariance is standard on negatively curved spaces, but oscillations can destroy positive definiteness. This theorem identifies a complete and sharp continuous region in the integrable harmonic-analysis regime a>1, including exact boundary and low-frequency failure mechanism, reducing an infinite spectral inequality to one explicit algebraic condition. The curvature-sensitive barrier is distinct from the flat-space bound.
